audience: HR and people teams that keep employee records, clock-ins and absences in BrightHR

useCases.title: Review who is employed and their job titles
useCases.text: List the employees of your organisation with job titles, start and end dates and status. Filter by email, external reference or termination status.

useCases.title: Check when an employee clocked in and out
useCases.text: Find the employee, then read the clock-in and clock-out times with breaks and notes for a date range. Page through the results with the continuation token.

useCases.title: Review approved absences for an employee
useCases.text: Find the employee, then read the approved holiday, sickness and time off in lieu for a date range. Lateness is not included.

useCases.title: Link employees to ids in another system
useCases.text: Read the employees, then set the external reference of each one to its id in another system. Pass null to clear a reference.
